ios.desc:
How Cuff Works:

1. Create your profile (real first name, 18+ age verification, interests, bio, and a profile photo).

2. Browse active profiles from the past week, sorted by most recently active.

3. Send a like to people you'd like to meet.

4. If it's mutual, you become Matches and can message or video call each other.

Cuff is a profile-based dating platform built around mutual selection and consent.
You can only message or video call someone after you both match.

Safety:
- Profile photos are checked for safety before being shown in Discover.
- You can report and unmatch at any time.

Have fun meeting new people :)

A subscription may be required to access certain features.

Terms of Use: https://renaissanceapps.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://renaissanceapps.com/privacy-policy
